mod.name: Simple VS Manager
mod.text:
A simple mod manager and launcher for everyday use! I know, I know, another mod manager...

I made it mostly for me (at least in the beginning!), I think it's pretty nice as an alternative to the mod menu ingame - just a bit easier to get an overview and see whats been updated, then launch the game from it.

Download from Github or directly from this page

If you get virus/security warnings sometimes downloading from a source such as Github helps.

Visit the Discord server to add suggestions, report issues or ask questions

Any suggestions are welcome - random ideas, code improvements, performance issues etc.

 

Why it might be useful

  • No installer; simply extract the zip and open the .exe!
  • No login, no install, no separate VS installs or importing mod folders
  • Update mods, all at once or selected, solve mod dependencies, skip versions, and see every new changelog when updating
  • Modlists - share your Modlists online in a dedicated tab and install other peoples Modlists. You can also save your list as an importable PDF that actually looks OK.
  • QoL - select and delete mods easily, launch game button, update notifications, tag sorting, presets for enabled/disabled mods, menu for opening those damn folders you always have to navigate to...
  • Mod DB Search/Browse - fast integrated mod browser, also with the option to use relevant search to actually prioritize what you write instead of sorting after downloads etc.
  • User Reports System - a fast way to judge if a mod is compatible or not with your game version, see what other users have reported and share your own result to help the community!
  • Game Profiles (Multiple VS versions) - set a separate Game and Data folder for each profile and switch easily between multiple VS installations.
  • Customizable - hide/show and move columns, custom color theme, compact view

 

Other things it does

  • If enabled, backup Data folder every time the game is launched through the manager, with ability to rollback.
  • Set your existing Vintage Story shortcut as a Launch Game option in case you're using command line arguments
  • Switch between any version of a mod using a dropdown list
  • You can toggle Disable Internet Access to opt out of all that nice stuff above
  • Change to another VintagestoryData folder location
  • Color themes, as well as custom colors
  • Creates backup modlists for every big action, allowing you to restore a timestamped modlist
  • "Uninstall" option that deletes every folder and file created by the app.
  • "Server options" to enable a "Copy to Server" button for selected mods, gives a command to install the mod to paste in game.

 

Good to know

  • Does not create any new Mods directory - uses the Mods directory in your VintagestoryData folder
  • Basically syncs with the Mods directory and the clientsettings.json, if you delete a mod in the manager it is deleted from the folder, and vice versa.
  • As default all mods, and their versions, are cached (stored) on your computer so you do not have to redownload when switching between modlists for example
  • Install by just unpacking the zip file and and running Simple VS Manager.exe

 

Modlists

  • Save currently installed mods as .json, .pdf or to the online database
  • Import other users .json and .pdf files, or browse the online database
  • To include a mods config in the modlist, select it and make sure the path to the config is set. You will be asked which mod configs you want to include when saving.
  • Use the Scan for mod config files option in the Help & Advanced menu to identify some of the configs
  • Does not include the actual mod zip files, the manager will download the mods from the Mod DB or use the cache if available

 

User Reports

  • Help the community out - if your installed mods are stable mark them as "No issues noticed" or "Fully functional" if you're confident. 
  • Does a mod have some minor issues but still does its job? Vote "Some issues but works".
  • If a mod is outdated or has serious issues which impacts the core functionality of the mod, use "Not functional".
  • And lastly for mods that crashes or freezes the game, "Crashes/freezes game".
  • You have one vote per specific combination of your installed mod version and your installed VS version.
  • Installed mods will show the most voted option for your specific VS & mod version, Mod DB will show for your specific VS version and the latest mod version.
  • Thanks for voting!

 

Things to know if you want to use it

  • Connects to the internet, namely to the Vintage Story Mod DB API
  • Creates a folder in your AppData/Local folder called "Simple VS Manager", contains a config file, cached mods (if enabled) and presets/modlists
  • Just like the ingame mod menu, it uses the normal Mods directory, so if you delete a mod in the manager it's deleted from the folder
  • To use the Modlist cloud functionality, a file called "firebase-auth" is created in the "Simple VS Manager" folder. A backup is also created in AppData/Local/SVSM Backup
  • I am not a professional developer, in fact I'm not a professional anything, so please report any of the plentiful bugs you encounter so I can tell a robot to fix it :)

 

Troubleshooting

  • Windows 10 or 11 only and requires the .net 8 Desktop Runtime which you should have installed if you are running VS 1.21+
  • If you are still running 1.20 or older, install the .net8 runtime from the Vintage Story Client Area page.
  • As with any zipped .exe files (that's not from a known source etc) there will be false positive virus warnings - if you feel unsafe downloading this I recommend you don't download this!
  • Github source is available for those who wants to check out the code (it's a mess) or build themselves.

releases.changelog:
Main features

 

  • Added modlist groups
    • Combine several local modlists into one group, each modlist becomes a reference to the original modlist
    • Any changes made to the original modlist will be reflected right away in the modlist group
    • Drag and drop modlists to create or expand a group
    • Choose which version or configuration to use when grouped modlists contain the same mod, use the "Fix duplicate mods" button
  • Added a dedicated Settings window
    • Just felt nice, all the options are still in the menus though.
  • Replaced the floating mod information window with a side pane
    • Select an installed mod to view its information and available actions, now as a docked style side panel
    • Move the side pane to either the left or right of the installed mods list
  • Added right-click context menus
    • Right-click installed mods to activate, update, configure, locate, or delete them
    • Right-click local and online modlists to quickly access their available actions, like adding a online modlist to your local modlists
    • Right-click installed-mod column headings to show or hide columns
  • Improved the Mod Database tab
    • Click a mod to see its full description, screenshots, statistics, and download options
    • Optionally reuse previous search results for faster browsing
  • Improved update, launch, and modlist tools
    • Copy all update notes from the update window with one button
    • Save an online modlist to your local collection
    • Optionally close Simple VS Manager after successfully launching Vintage Story, look in the File menu

Main fixes

 

  • Scrolling might work better for users experiencing issues
  • Improved text and window layouts
  • Modlist descriptions can now be longer and are easier to edit
  • The update window handles long changelogs without expanding or overflowing incorrectly.
  • App window can now be much smaller vertically by dragging

 

And probably a lot of other things that I've forgotten... Thank you for all the feedback and suggestions!

Features added:

  • Set max number of VintagestoryData backups, the oldest one will be deleted when the max number is reached.
  • Date Modified added as a column in the installed mods list.
  • Target VS Version (File menu)
    • The manager will now only update to mod versions marked as compatible with this value.
    • Downloading from Mod Database will also only download the mod version compatible with the set target VS version.
    • Choose "Latest" to always download the latest version of mods regardless.

Features added:

  • Custom themes can be saved
  • Base custom themes on the built in themes
  • Ability to turn off visual hover effects


Improvements and fixes:

  • CTRL+A now works properly with search box
  • Scrolling to the bottom of the mod browser could cause issues with loading more mods
  • Changing themes broke scrolling
  • Title and description was overlapping in modlist section
  • Clarified text in the menu guide

2.0.0 (Major rework)

Features implemented:

  • New Mod Browser! Faster, less complex.
  • Performance optimization, overall but especially for large (300+) mod folders
  • Design changes - cleaner and more responsive
  • Proper tab switching between the three main views
  • Multiple configs for each mod
  • Mod browser: Favorites (add/remove favorites, filtering, etc.)
  • Mod browser: Relevant search (optional toggle to ignore sorting and prioritize best title matches)
  • Optimized votes and modlist database traffic, with automatic migration to the new database for users
  • Ability to change the directory of the manager’s config folder (Simple VS Manager folder)
  • Logging options saved to a .txt file: app launched/exited, mod installed, mod updated, mod deleted, errors and debug info
  • The three default themes can now be loaded into the custom theme as a starting point
  • More help options and a menu guide to explain all the menu items
  • Resizing of installed mods rows improved, can now shrink even more if columns are disabled
  • More stuff I forget!

• Improvements and Fixes:
    • User report system database traffic mitigation
    • Modlists "Local" and "Online" tab persistent selection

• Features added:
    • Automatic backup of VintagestoryData folder when "Launch Vintage Story" button is pressed
      • Experimental, report any bugs please - and let me know if the backups takes up a lot of space (Shouldn't really)
      • Disabled by default, enable in File menu
      • Roll back to the exact state of the data folder at the moment of game launch - so mods, clientsettings, configs etc
      • Unchanged game files will not be copied again to save disk space - they are saved once and then referenced
      • You cannot roll back to a backup if the backup was made with another data folder set, also the Vintage Story version has to match.

• Improvements & Fixes:
    • Fixed bug where loading a modlist would add the mod to the disabledMods list in clientsettings.json, but without the version number, causing a crash when joining servers
    • Modlist tab now includes Local mods, switch between local and online easily
    • Other stuff I can't remember right now

• Features added:
    • Save Modlists as PDF - generates a PDF with name, description etc and all the mods (titles linked to their mod db page).
    • PDF Modlists can be loaded just like any other modlist, mods and configs saved in PDF metadata
    • Drag and drop .json or .pdf modlists to load them
    • Game Profiles - switch between multiple Vintage Story installations. Set a separate Game (Vintagestory) and Data (VintagestoryData) folder.
    • Each Game Profile keeps its own custom shortcut, skipped mod versions and mod usage tracking for the user report reminder. All Game Profiles share the same caches and all other config settings.
    • Disable Auto-refresh (in File menu) - for faster loading and less bandwidth usage, use the Refresh button to manually update whenever you want
    • Scan for mod config files (in Help & Advanced menu) - simple heuristic matching scan to automatically set config paths for mods.
    • Copy install command for server - enable "Enable server options" in "Help & Advanced" menu and a "Copy to Server" button appears on selected mods. Copies a install command to run on servers, for example "/moddb install betterruins@0.5.3"
  • Improvements and fixes:
    • Huge performance increase, removed redundant update functions, fixed duplicate scanning etc
    • Hiding a column now disables loading of column data - for example hide "Tags" and "User Reports" for a performance increase.
    • Much faster tab switching, separated Installed mods and Mod DB to separate datagrids
    • "Menu Guide" in the "Help & Advanced" menu now describes every menu item and its function
    • Modlist description box size increased
    • "Side" column now sorting correctly
    • Other minor design and performance fixes

Improvements and fixes:

  • Now properly syncs with the enabled/disabled mod status set in the game and vice versa
  • Additional checks for new mod versions on the ModDB

• Improvements and fixes:
    • "Update All" button renamed to "Manage Updates"
    • New sorting options for ModDB
    • Clarified downloads amounts in ModDB
    • Fixed bug with tooltips and descriptions for changelogs did not wrap properly
    • Potential fix for button titles not displaying properly with certain system settings

• Features added:
    • Mod compatibility voting system
    • "Clear all cache" added in Help menu
    • "Help!" dialog added in Help menu
    • Experimental mod debugging added in Help menu
    • New "Skip" button in the Update mods dialog to never notify about a certain mod version again
  • Improvements & Fixes:
    • Compatibility checks now only check major and minor versions by default (1.21.5) to actually make it useful.
    • Fixed bug with playeruid containing characters such as "/"
    • Moved the Simple VS Manager folder to AppData/Local (Users will be prompted to approve a transfer from old location)
    • Created a proper backup for firebase-auth.json so it can be restored by user
    • The little mod info box (when selecting a mod) can now be moved around
    • Made sure the manager never loads the three base VS mods in case they are in the wrong folder
    • Fixed bug where mod zips installed outside of the manager would only get their contents replaced but not their name
    • Saving a modlist to cloud will now ask to replace a already saved modlist if they have the same name

• Features added:
    • Show/Hide Columns in the View menu
    • Update All reworked - now opens a dialog with more choices and an easy way to view changelogs
  • Improvements and fixes
    • Update All button will now show how many mods can be updated
    • Dialog after updating with the Update All button shows which mods were updated and their changelogs
    • Fixed bug: mod versions with "-dev" or "-rc" etc showing "(installed)" in version dropdown
    • Loading a modlist is now "safer" - disabled certain buttons, menus and switching tabs during loading
    • Online modlists will now show when they were added (only new uploads)
    • Rebuild button will now do another internet connection test against the Mod DB and abort if it fails

• Features added:
    • Color Themes, including custom that can be changed in the app
    • "Side" column added
    • Mod DB cards will say "compatible" if they are marked as such with the installed vs version
    • Added experimental "Check mods compatibility" where you can check your current installed mods against any Vintage Story version and see what mods are incompatible with that.
    • Ctrl + A to select all mods, Delete key to delete
    • Refresh button (quick refresh) and Rebuild button (deletes all stored info and cache and fetches new info from the mod db, use if you experience problems)
  • Improvements and fixes:
    • "Update all" now works properly when skipping one mod
    • Various performance improvements
    • Cleaned up some design, menus etc
    • Uninstall option in "Help > Advanced" to delete every file stored by the manager (not your mods ofcourse!)

• Features added:
    • Online modlist sharing (Beta)
    • Backup restore points
    • Load more search/browse results button in Mod DB
    • Filtering/sorting by tags
    • Author included in Mod DB search
    • "Launch Vintage Story" now always launches the game with the set Data folder as --dataPath
    • Spinning loading thingy added
  • Improvements and fixes:
    • Overall performance with large amount of mods improved
    • Compatibility warnings now works correctly
    • Resolve dependencies was sometimes not working
    • Lots of small fixes and design

• New mod page
  • Feature: "The .exe will actually start the app now"
  • Feature: "Select a Vintage Story shortcut to use that for the Launch Game button"
  • Improvement: "Added common vintage story game paths to look at before asking the user to browse"
